message_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"claim-run-46ba5957-69f4-4dda-a0ee-6e0c97cb8fb6-1","status":"conflict","nature":"confirmed_conflict","category":"object_state","severity":"high","explanation":"同一时刻，草稿称镜头 R4 是琥珀色玻璃，而证据称 R4 所对应的西侧孔径镜头是透明玻璃而非琥珀色玻璃。","reasoning":"草稿声称“At 18点 on the same day, lens R4 is amber glass.”，证据 span fixture-span-basalt_observatory-1 在同一时间“At 18点 on the same day”确认镜头 R4 就是已安装的西侧孔径镜头，证据 span fixture-span-basalt_observatory-2 又在同一时间“At 18点 on the same day”说明该西侧孔径镜头是透明玻璃而非琥珀色玻璃。两者主体（镜头 R4 / 西侧孔径镜头）、范围（玻璃状态）和时间（同一天 18点）完全重叠，因此不能同时为真。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":"At 18点 on the same day","evidence_anchor":"At 18点 on the same day","relation":"explicit_overlap"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-1","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-1","relation":"supports","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-1"]},{"chapter_id":"fixture-chapter-basalt_observatory-2","span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-2","relation":"contradicts","sufficiency":"sufficient","related_memory_ids":["fixture-memory-basalt_observatory-2"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-1","role":"current_context"},{"span_id":"fixture-span-basalt_observatory-2","role":"prior_state"}],"suggested_revision":{"before":"At 18点 on the same day, lens R4 is amber glass.","after":"At 18点 on the same day, lens R4 is clear glass, not amber glass."},"available_actions":["edit","apply_suggestion","keep_intentional","false_positive"]}]}
